verdict.rationale: Undermind advertises enterprise "Programmatic queries via API" and runs an MCP server, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The MCP server is a separate integration story and does not count as a published API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
